title: Serpent Sorceress Ritual
description: A surreal fantasy scene dominated by a giant cosmic eye in a starry sky, from which a large blue serpent emerges. A female figure in flowing white robes with turquoise hair stands centrally, holding colorful orbs while the serpent coils around her. Below are potted glowing plants, a white futuristic vehicle with headlights, and groups of robed figures in a desert landscape with rock formations.
prompt: Surreal fantasy scene with a massive cosmic eye filled with stars and a white serpent floating in a dark cave ceiling dripping with orange liquid and blue crystals. A woman with turquoise hair in traditional white robes stands in the center with a large iridescent blue and purple serpent coiled around her body, extending her hand with floating colorful orbs. In the foreground are glowing potted alien plants, a white futuristic vehicle with blue headlights, and groups of robed figures standing in a desert under a starry sky with rock mesas.
